content: The HWPX template replacement task was successful (Reward 1.0). Key success factors for HWPX manipulation included: 1) Extracting the HWPX as a ZIP archive. 2) Using a recursive flattening function for the JSON data to match dot-notation placeholders (e.g., `address.city`). 3) Crucially, removing the `<hp:linesegarray>` (layout cache) elements from any modified `<hp:p>` (paragraph) tags; failing to do this often causes rendering artifacts or overlapping text in HWPX viewers. 4) Using `lxml` for robust XML parsing while preserving namespaces, which is vital for the HWPX schema.
